bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 108,000 views on one reel. The only product is a spreadsheet.
beats.text: Your step-by-step investing reel passed 108,000 views, and you bring seven years in asset management in the City. But what people can get from you today is a free mini-course, a budget tracker sheet and broker sign-up links.

beats.title: People already message you for help.
beats.text: You post almost every day, 281 YouTube videos in 14 months, and you wrote that you get messages every day from people who feel they've left it too late. Those messages are demand without anywhere to go.

beats.title: The help people ask for isn't something they can buy.
beats.text: Someone who wants you to walk them through their budget, their ISA and their first investments has a spreadsheet or a Trading 212 link to choose from. There's no way to actually work with you, so the trust you build goes to the platforms.

beats.title: “My channel is still small.” A programme doesn't need a big one.
beats.text: A small-group programme needs a handful of people at a time, not thousands. The 108,000-view reel shows the reach is there, and an application keeps it to people who are ready.
beats.quote: “I get messages every day from people feeling like they’ve left it too late.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: Your money just disappears

cards.title: Investing feels like a closed club
cards.body: Stocks, ISAs, SIPPs. You'd start if someone just showed you how.

mechanism.title: Get on top, one step at a time.
mechanism.body: No shortcuts and no jargon. In eight weeks you build the foundations in order: a budget that works, savings and debt sorted, the right accounts, and your first investments, explained by someone who spent seven years in asset management.

qualification.title: Apply for the Get On Top programme

questions.q: Where are you with your money right now?
What do you want help with most?
What's the money decision you keep putting off?
Can you give it about an hour a week for 8 weeks?
Do you understand that investing involves risk and you may get back less than you put in?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the programme now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the programme isn't the right next step for you. Start with Dahlia's free mini-course and her videos, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to get on top of your money?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one call, a straight answer.
finalCta.disclaimer: Educational content only. Nothing here is personalised financial advice. Capital at risk: the value of investments can go down as well as up, and you may get back less than you invest. Tax treatment depends on your circumstances and can change.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your monthly income, spending and any accounts you already have.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Dahlia

preCallEmails.subject: It's not too late
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people who message me think they've left it too late. They haven't. What they're missing is the order: budget, savings, the right accounts, then investing.

That's exactly how the programme is built.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Dahlia

preCallEmails.subject: "I already have your budget sheet"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great, then you've got the first tool.

The programme is the rest: eight weeks, a small group and me, so the sheet turns into a plan you follow.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Dahlia

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Dahlia

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Dahlia's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Dahlia

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Dahlia
